source.title: Changes in the Board of Directors (July 2022)
source.content:
Due to the vacancies of two positions in the Board of Directors, an anonymous election took place on June 30, 2022 to elect new members. The election was done according to [Motion 5.2021.1: Election of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf).

The Board received applications from:

Blake Thompson
Calvin Nielson
Somya Srivastava
<!-- break -->
We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that both Blake and Somya were elected as new members of the WCA Board of Directors! We wish them the best of luck with their duties! We thank Calvin for his application and his continued commitment to the WCA.

Applications from all three candidates can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bJVMDrKclbY2h5F3e6Qs9OZ-UpYU6kAr?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2022 年 7 月）
translation.content:
因董事会有两个席位空缺，WCA 于 2022 年 6 月 30 日举行不记名选举，选出新成员。选举依照《[决议 5.2021.1：董事选举](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)》进行。

董事会收到以下人员的申请：

- Blake Thompson
- Calvin Nielson
- Somya Srivastava

<!-- break -->

我们很高兴宣布，选举顺利完成，Blake 和 Somya 均当选为 WCA 董事会新成员！祝他们工作顺利！感谢 Calvin 提交申请，并一直为 WCA 付出。

三位申请人的材料均可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1bJVMDrKclbY2h5F3e6Qs9OZ-UpYU6kAr?usp=sharing)查看。
